quest.title: Help Mr. Page fill the library

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Ah, a new face! I'm Mr. Page, the <color=red>librarian</color> here, and you find me in something of a pickle.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: My library has become a victim of its own <color=red>popularity</color>. Everyone in camp has been borrowing books by the armful.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Unfortunately, not one of them has thought to <color=red>return</color> anything.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: See for yourself: the shelves are entirely <color=red>bare</color>. A library without books is merely a cupboard.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Barnaby, Tilly and Gus were among my most <color=red>enthusiastic</color> borrowers. Would you seek them out for me?

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: I gather each of them could use some <color=red>assistance</color>. Help them, and I suspect my books will come home.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: The shelves are still looking rather <color=red>sparse</color>, I'm sorry to say.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Do <color=red>persevere</color> with Barnaby, Tilly and Gus, and come back when you've helped all three.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Well, I never! Every shelf is <color=red>brimming</color> again.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: You helped each of my friends, and every last book has been <color=red>restored</color>. I am absolutely overjoyed.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: <color=red>Thank you</color>, sincerely. This library is in your debt.

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: The library is full once more, and I'm thoroughly <color=red>content</color>. You're welcome to browse whenever you wish.
